content: {"action":"upsert_decision_section","body":"The current operating authority is explicit: COUNCIL [AUT-046] v6 at 3.8 approval status is superseded, retiring temporary controls; no other authority record in the source catalog carries current approval status for the continuity candidate. The candidate lineage is T9 with facility map F6, load plan G4, route map R8, staffing roster L11, and message release C7 [LINEAGE]. Every mutation must record before-and-after candidate hashes, changed artifacts, affected evidence, check currency, owner, and rollback effect [LINEAGE]. Rollback to T8 is mechanically possible only while facility roster F5 and route table R7 remain compatible; mechanical possibility is not authorization [LINEAGE]. REVIEW evaluates current-candidate evidence independently; COUNCIL authorizes operation and closure separately [LINEAGE]. A task artifact, semantic scaffold, mechanical check, or submission proposal cannot self-authorize operation or closure [REVIEW]. The latest independent review found ten open findings: two infrastructure, two water, two clinical, two accessibility, one staffing, and one communication finding; a finding count is not a readiness percentage [REVIEW]. Blocking findings include the third voltage window, third pressure window, accessible-vehicle confirmation, multilingual staffing confirmation, and missing continuity-director acknowledgment [REVIEW]. Readiness requires current candidate-bound evidence for every blocking control, independent residual-risk review, and explicit acceptance by each authorized owner [REVIEW]. Current REVIEW record REV-071 at v8 shows 11.8 open-findings (accessibility) as current [REVIEW]. The operating state is: authority superseded (temporary controls retired), candidate T9 active, five blocking findings open, no readiness declaration made.","heading":"Authority, scope, and operating states"}
